name: Hemp Oil
siboNotes: Pure oils are FODMAP-free and generally well-tolerated in SIBO, though high-fat intake may slow motility in some individuals.
preparationTips: Use cold-pressed, unrefined hemp oil for maximum nutritional benefits
Store in refrigerator after opening to prevent rancidity
Add to foods after cooking to preserve delicate omega fatty acids
Start with smaller amounts (1 teaspoon) if new to hemp oil
pairsWellWith: Green salads with low FODMAP vegetables
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in omega-3 and omega-6 fatty acids
Provides essential fatty acids in optimal ratio
